# openmetadata_dashboard_service (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata Dashboard Service. Updates are sent as a JSON Patch of the changed fields, so a service whose connection is managed in the OpenMetadata UI keeps its connection and secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service with no external connection, e.g. to hold hand-made data models.
resource "openmetadata_dashboard_service" "saved_reports" {
  name         = "SavedReports"
  service_type = "CustomDashboard"
  description  = "Saved reports: parameterised SQL with documented output columns."
  domains      = ["Data"]

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# An ingested BI service whose connection (and secrets) stay managed in the OpenMetadata UI.
# Omitting connection_json means the provider never sends or changes the connection.
resource "openmetadata_dashboard_service" "tableau" {
  name         = "Tableau Dashboards"
  service_type = "Tableau"
  description  = "Our Tableau dashboards"
  domains      = ["Data"]

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name identifying the resource.
- `service_type` (String) Type of dashboard service (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Superset, PowerBI, Metabase, CustomDashboard).

### Optional

- `connection_json` (String, Sensitive) Connection configuration as a JSON string; the structure depends on service_type. Omit it to manage the connection in the OpenMetadata UI: the provider then never sends or changes it. On create, an omitted connection defaults to {"config": {"type": <service_type>}}, which is enough for CustomDashboard. Schemas: https://github.com/open-metadata/OpenMetadata/tree/main/openmetadata-spec/src/main/resources/json/schema/entity/services/connections/dashboard
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the resource.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains this service belongs to. Omit to leave domains as set in OpenMetadata.
- `hard_delete` (Boolean) Hard-delete the service on destroy. Defaults to false: destroy soft-deletes, which can be restored from the OpenMetadata UI. Deleting a service always removes its dashboards, charts and data models with it.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the resource.
- `id` (String) UUID of the resource assigned by OpenMetadata.

### Nested Schema for `owners`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner entity (user or team).
